ds.name: GOV.UK Design System
ds.description: UK Government Digital Service design system. Accessibility-first, GDS Transport font, govuk-blue #1d70b8 brand, #ffdd00 focus highlight, zero border-radius policy.

tokens.note: primary = govuk-blue #1d70b8 (brand functional colour); focus = #ffdd00 (WCAG-mandated yellow highlight); text = #0b0c0c (near-black); buttons use green #0f7a52 as primary action colour on DS site, while govuk.com header uses blue #1d70b8.
